title: Thai Coconut Lemongrass Pan Sauce
description: Bruised lemongrass infuses coconut milk for a fragrant fish sauce pairing.

steps.title: Start the sauce
steps.text: Warm {oil} in the 10-inch HexClad skillet over medium-low heat.

steps.title: Release the aromatics
steps.text: Gently crush the herbs. Warm {lemongrass}, {ginger} in the oil for 30 seconds without browning.

steps.title: Simmer the base
steps.text: Whisk in {coconut}, {broth}, {amino}, {honey} gradually. Simmer gently for 8 minutes, then lift out the whole herb.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Pour the slurry into the simmering sauce while whisking. Bubble gently for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Finish the sauce
steps.text: Fold in {lime} off heat. Measure into a heatproof jug; add hot water to reach 1 cup, or simmer excess away before serving.

notes: Yield: 1 cup. Low-sodium option for the full batch: reduce coconut aminos to 3 g and keep the same final yield. Use unsalted broth throughout. Option A uses the listed seasonings. For a gentler Option B, omit citrus or vinegar and replace its weight with water. Make ahead: chill in small jars for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze in quarter-cup portions up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: whisk over low heat to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat as above. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 46 kcal, 0.2 g protein, 4.3 g total carbohydrate, 3.1 g fat, 0.1 g fiber, 65 mg sodium. Low-sodium version per 1/4 cup: 44 kcal, 0.2 g protein, 3.7 g total carbohydrate, 3.1 g fat, 0.1 g fiber, 25 mg sodium.
